0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_GREETING_KURENAI_000_000
0.description: With your cooperation, I am confident that we can convince the citizens to embrace change.

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_GREETING_KURENAI_000_001
1.description: Smiles are beginning to appear on the people's faces, and it is in no small part due to you, my friend.

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_GREETING_KURENAI_000_002
2.description: Each day is filled with new discoveries. Though the work can be tiring, I could not imagine a more worthwhile way to expend my energies.

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_GREETING_KURENAI_000_003
3.description: We are so close now, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. With but a little more effort, we shall realize our dream of opening Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato to the world!

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_GREETING_KURENAI_000_004
4.description: My friend, full glad am I to see you. Have you come with a delivery? Or do you perchance have new garments for me to try?

49.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_TUTORIAL_000_000
49.description: Help Kurenai achieve her goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with her and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_TUTORIAL_001_000
60.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Kurenai's trust.

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_TUTORIAL_001_001
61.description: With each successful delivery, Kurenai will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and Kurenai's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about your business partner.

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_TUTORIAL_001_002
62.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items Kurenai needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your new business partner!

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_001_000
64.description: This is the Gyr Abanian remedy? It certainly smells...<cough>...effective. As they say, the best medicine is often the hardest to swallow.

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_001_001
65.description: Hmmm, yes, impressively sturdy yet suitably light. A harpoon such as this should serve us well against sharks and help to keep our waters safe.

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_001_002
66.description: My, such thick, warm garments! Naught that we have could compare to this. Thus clothed, we need no longer shiver through the night.

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_001_003
67.description: We have ever only seen the Ruby Sea as our home, and not a place for the mysterious and exotic. To think that you could bring forth such a splendid object from these depths! You never cease to amaze me, my friend.

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_001_004
68.description: Though it may strike you as silly, it gives me uncommon joy to behold treasures from above. I could stare at such a beautiful thing all day long... <sigh>

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_002_000
74.description: Apparently, this powder, made by grinding down rock, finds use in numerous traditional Ala Mhigan remedies. 'Tis an innovation born of the peculiarities of the region.

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_002_001
75.description: Ah, of course. Though metal has its uses, in our watery domain, bone and stone shall ever be the materials of choice for weapons. Our guards shall be well pleased.

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_002_002
76.description: So, by coating garments with this fluid, one can increase their ability to ward off cold? That something so wondrous should exist! Our citizens will surely be impressed!

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_002_003
77.description: I had never harbored much interest in trinkets, but even I cannot help but be mesmerized by this resplendent jewel! To think that such beauty slumbers in our very own waters...

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_002_004
78.description: By the kami, such a magnificent beast this feather must have come from! Ah, what I would not give to behold the creature with mine own eyes as it takes wing.

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_003_000
84.description: I understand the people of Gyr Abania use horn and bone meal to brew medicinal teas. I am hopeful that the bones of this curefish will provide like benefits.

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_003_001
85.description: Such imposing fangs, as sharp as they are long! Fine harpoon blades these shall make, in the spirit of Gridanian philosophy. We have much to learn from those dwellers of the forest.

86.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_003_002
86.description: The resourceful denizens of Coerthas apparently weave dragon scales into their garments for added warmth. Borrowing from this inspired idea, we shall avail ourselves of the scales of this fish, which has evolved to survive in extreme cold.

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_003_003
87.description: Oh my, this clam is a veritable giant among its kind! The pearls it yields is certain to impress the people of the surface!

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_KNOWLEDGE_KURENAI_003_004
88.description: What a peculiar creature... Verily, the Sea of Clouds is a mysterious place. Fauna such as this will surely pique the citizens' curiosity.

94.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_JUDGEMENT_KURENAI_000_000
94.description: Now then, if I may take a closer look... Yes, the quality is above reproach, as solid as the bedrock upon which we build. It shall serve our people most admirably.

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_JUDGEMENT_KURENAI_000_001
95.description: Now then, if I may take a closer look... Ah, now this is a fine example of its kind, a shining, shimmering coral that rises above its neighbors. Your reputation is truly well deserved!

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_JUDGEMENT_KURENAI_000_002
96.description: Now then, if I may take a closer look... By the kami, not even the sun-illuminated splendor of the ocean could compare to its brilliance. Yours is the work of the divine, my friend!

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_JUDGEMENT_KURENAI_000_003
97.description: Truly, this is a thing of beauty. With a signature product of such rarity and quality, it shan't be long ere the name Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato resounds the world over!

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_JUDGEMENT_KURENAI_000_004
98.description: N-Now, where was I? Ah, yes. The world is home to wonders that far surpass aught I am capable of imagining, and I am grateful for these little glimpses of what lies beyond. You have my gratitude.

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_FULLBAG_000_000
103.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_FULLBAG_000_001
104.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with Kurenai once more.

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_BEFRANKUP_KURENAI_000_000
105.description: With your help, we now have enough doses of the remedy to distribute among those most vulnerable among us. I pray this will allow us to prevent the illness's spread.

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_BEFRANKUP_KURENAI_001_000
106.description: And with this, we now have enough harpoons to arm our guards. Regular patrols may finally commence!

107.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_BEFRANKUP_KURENAI_002_000
107.description: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. With the items you have brought us, none of our old and infirm need fear Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato's cold nights any longer. I shall see to their distribution at once.

108.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_BEFRANKUP_KURENAI_003_000
108.description: Thanks to your tireless efforts, we now have a sufficient stock of products that may represent Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato. I pray that they will meet with Jikkan's satisfaction.

113.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_000
113.description: Glad tidings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Thanks to the remedy you have been bringing us, even those who took ill were able to recover swiftly. For the first time in recent memory, there have been no severe cases, and certainly no deaths.

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_001
114.description: Having experienced firsthand the medicine's efficacy, both our healers and citizens alike have been clamoring for more. Never have I seen my people so happy, so full of hope.

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_AURASUI00481_001_002
115.description: Lady Hisui? My dear mother─she too has been feeling unwell. Might there be any more of that remedy still?

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_003
116.description: Had you come asking earlier, my reply would have been no. But for a blessing, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> here has just furnished us with more. I shall see that it is delivered to you.

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_AURASUI00481_001_004
117.description: So you are <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I have heard about you.

118.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_005
118.description: Aye, this is the kindly adventurer who has been working with Sanana. We owe our good health to their tireless efforts.

119.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_AURASUI00481_001_006
119.description: I shall be forthright. I still mistrust outsiders. Many of us do.

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_AURASUI00481_001_007
120.description: And yet...we are grateful. While we do not yet welcome you as the Ruby Princess does, we offer you our thanks all the same.

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_001_008
121.description: “As the Ruby Princess does”... Hmph, I'd love to see the looks on their faces when they learn who you really are.

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_009
122.description: Oh, Sanana, you mustn't entertain such thoughts, not even in jest. All know that the Ruby Princess must live out her days within the palace. So has it always been. Should my presence here come to light, the citizens would be up in arms.

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_010
123.description: We can ill afford to have them so distracted. No, I would have my people focus upon only one thing: embracing the outside world. Though they still have a long way to go, we will guide them, one sure step at a time.

124.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_000
124.description: As anticipated, our guards were very pleased with their new harpoons. What I did not anticipate, however, was that our youths would also take a shine to them. They were quite fascinated by its foreign construction.

125.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_002_001
125.description: (-???-)And this is a source of delight for you, Hisui? Placing one's trust in land-dwellers... I cannot think of a greater folly. It will not do for this sentiment to spread.

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_002
126.description: Jik...I mean, Lord Jikkan! And Lord Shiosai besides. To what do I owe the honor...?

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_003
127.description: It has come to my attention that our citizens are being led astray. Seduced first by outsider medicines, and now outsider weapons.

128.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_002_004
128.description: I labor to comprehend how the princess could permit this. 'Tis bad enough that the guards have taken up these harpoons; now our youths desire them too! Mark my words, this can end in naught but bloodshed.

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_002_005
129.description: Lest we forget, both the Confederacy and the Kojin were dragged into Doma's bloody conflict against the Empire.

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_002_006
130.description: Should their leader, this Lord Hien, learn that our people are arming themselves, in his insatiable thirst for war, he may well come banging on our gates to demand our participation. Surely you see the danger.

131.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SHIOSAI_002_007
131.description: With respect, my lord, may I remind you that this is not the palace. There are eyes and ears all around us─<hex:021A020203>foreign<hex:021A020103> eyes and ears.

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SHIOSAI_002_008
132.description: I would remind you also of the agreement: that you and your fellow elders would watch how the citizens respond to Her Grace's plan. As impartial observers. Your words can ill be described as impartial.

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_009
133.description: We have naught to gain by cowering inside our little bubble! Nay, by shutting out the rest of the world in the name of tradition, we but consign ourselves to a slow demise!

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_002_010
134.description: You presume to lecture me, Hisui? You who know little and less of worldly matters, whose sole purpose is to attend Her Grace.

135.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_002_012
135.description: Hmmm, for a moment, though, I thought the princess herself was addressing me. You have ever shared her looks, but it seems you have taken on her mannerisms as well.

136.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_013
136.description: Er...y-yes, it must be all the years serving Her Grace. I have...er, come to know her mind as though it were my own.

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_002_014
137.description: ...Hmph, well, I suppose this is but a fleeting infatuation with the novel and new. Given time, the people will remember the dangers that lurk without and come to their senses.

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_002_015
138.description: Now, there's a man you can love to hate. I take it he's the conservative-in-chief?

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_016
139.description: You might say that. And yet, independent of his influence, many others harbor the selfsame fear. The fear that, by throwing open Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato's gates, we would be swallowed up in a maelstrom of foreign agenda.

140.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_002_017
140.description: When a simple bloody harpoon can trigger such a fearful reaction... Your people really have no stomach for conflict. Well, no one with any sense would, but this is just unhealthy.

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_018
141.description: Indeed. 'Tis an irrational fear, ingrained over generations and perpetuated by willful ignorance. If we are to free ourselves from it, we must have the chance to know the world above.

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_000
142.description: I am pleased to say that your winter wares have been very well received. The old and infirm are singing their praises, and those around them cannot help but be impressed as well.

143.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_001
143.description: The items from above have improved our people's lives greatly, and Shiosai is making certain that the elders are aware of this fact. It cannot be long now, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Soon we will─

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_HISUI_003_004
146.description: Y-Your Grace... L-Lord Jikkan, he came without warning and...and forced me to reveal everything... <sob>

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_003_005
147.description: Your demeanor when last we spoke struck me as odd, and so I put a little test to the Ruby Princess. Imagine my surprise when I learned that she was in fact the lady-in-waiting, posing as our wise and noble ruler!

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_006
148.description: 'Twas my ploy and mine alone. I submit myself to any punishment you deem fit.

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_007
149.description: But this is no place to discuss such matters. Let us first return to Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato. If you would permit me one request, however, I would have a moment with my two companions.

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_003_008
150.description: Very well, I shall go on ahead. And though I do not think you will run, Hisui will return with me.

152.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_010
152.description: There is naught to forgive. 'Twas I who put you up to it. Go on, I shall join you anon.

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_012
154.description: And so it comes to this. The risk was ever present, and yet the disappointment... It is almost too much to bear...

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_000
155.description: I took the liberty of showing our people the signature product you have been bringing us. It seemed appropriate, seeing as it is to represent their home.

156.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_001
156.description: All were in awe of the foreign techniques employed in its creation, and full many of them were inspired to contribute like items of their own.

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_004_002
157.description: The quality doesn't compare to yours, of course, but it's none too shabby either. As a matter of fact, it's good enough for the House to deal in. By my reckoning, we've got enough hands to meet anticipated demand─assuming they're willing.

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_003
158.description: T-Truly!? If the House of Splendors should be willing to stock our products, we would be honored to supply them!

159.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_004_004
159.description: Glad to hear it. I must confess, though, I've been eyeing ways to turn a profit out of this for a while now. Grateful as I am for my life, I couldn't call myself a trader if I ignored the opportunity for an exclusive supply deal.

160.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_005
160.description: Oh? Is that the way of it? You did not give me that impression in the least.

161.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_004_006
161.description: Heh, you still have lots to learn about business, Princess. I'll have to teach you good and proper, else you're liable to be eaten alive out there.

162.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_004_007
162.description: You are all here. Good. I have...I have come to offer an apology.

163.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_004_008
163.description: Well, if it isn't Jikkan! An apology, you say? I take it you've seen all the good that's come of <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>'s handiwork?

164.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_004_009
164.description: Indeed. I have been observing our citizens. Never have I seen them so invigorated, so alive. Their passions enkindled by the prospect of having a product to call their own. As it stands, I believe that Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato would not only survive, but thrive, were we to emerge into the world.

165.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_004_010
165.description: This brings me to my apology. My fear of the unknown had blinded me to many things, not least of all to our people's potential. I see this now, as do my fellow elders. And I speak for all of us when I say that we would be grateful for your continued support of Her Grace's cause.

166.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_011
166.description: We are as newly hatched fish yet trying to find our way in a great ocean. I, too, ask for your continued support...though I myself can no longer be involved in this endeavor.

167.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_012
167.description: Ever since my charade was exposed, I have been prepared for this moment. Though I am grateful for being indulged these extra days of freedom, 'tis past time that I returned to my place, in the palace.

168.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_004_013
168.description: With regards to that, Your Grace. 'Tis my firm belief that one among us who harbors the greatest passion for the outside world should continue to collaborate with our visitors.

169.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_014
169.description: Indeed, Lord Jikkan. I doubt not that you and your fellow elders shall find a suitable replacement.

170.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_004_015
170.description: <sigh> For someone who advocates the need for change, Your Grace bends all too easily to tradition when it concerns yourself.

171.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_004_016
171.description: There is no need to find a replacement. For who harbors greater passion for the outside world than you?

173.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_004_018
173.description: Rest assured your lady-in-waiting has expressed her willingness to continue ruling in your stead. Your presence will still be required at functions of import, but outside of those times, you are free to continue as you are.

175.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_JIKKAN_004_020
175.description: Full certain, Your Grace. Remain with Sanana and <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Learn well from them. For the future of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato depends upon it.

176.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_100
176.description: Our people have begun to harbor interest in the outside world. We must nurture that interest by introducing more useful foreign items into their lives.

177.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_101
177.description: And for the next item, I ask that you bring equipment that might afford us protection against sharks. In the past, such things were unnecessary, as the people of Isari kept the creatures' population at bay through regular and large-scale fishing expeditions.

178.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_102
178.description: However, such expeditions were largely abandoned under imperial rule. As a result, shark numbers have multiplied to plague-like proportions, and in their competition for limited prey, the creatures have grown uncommonly savage.

179.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_103
179.description: In order to keep our citizens safe, I would commence regular patrols of the surrounding waters. Alas, our guards are ill equipped for such a dangerous task. Against a shark's tough skin, their weapons are as playthings.

180.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_104
180.description: Through the Blue Kojin, we acquired blades of steel from Kugane. Yet while these are indeed deadly sharp, their weight renders them unwieldy, not to mention they quickly go to rust.

181.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_105
181.description: What we need, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, is a weapon that shall neither rust nor be stopped by sharkskin. With your knowledge of techniques from above, could you please furnish us with such an item?

182.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SHIOSAI_002_100
182.description: Your Grace, if I may, there is a particular item that I would request of <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

183.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_101
183.description: But of course, Shiosai. None among us is more familiar with our people's daily lives than you. What is it that ails them?

184.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SHIOSAI_002_102
184.description: As Your Grace knows, we dwell at the bottom of the sea by virtue of the Kojin's enchantments. Yet though we have air to breathe and live, our home has ever been a bitterly cold place.

185.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SHIOSAI_002_103
185.description: Due to our closed environment, we cannot avail ourselves of the benefits of fire. And so we have had to endure, covering ourselves in such garments as we possess. While this may suffice for the young and healthy, the old and infirm struggle simply to survive.

186.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_104
186.description: Indeed, the cold has ever been a trial for us. Yet I have heard of a place above far colder still, a land of endless winter where ice falls instead of rain. There, a great nation thrives, and its people must have effective ways of coping in that frozen clime, such as garbs of transcendent warmth.

187.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_002_105
187.description: That's got to be Coerthas, I reckon. I've never been that far out of Ul'dah─at least not till now─but you've definitely been there, right, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

188.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SHIOSAI_002_106
188.description: A more dependable adventurer I have never known. I shall let you all return to your work, then. By your leave.

189.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_107
189.description: Permit me to echo Shiosai's sentiment. Truly, we are blessed to have a dependable ally such as you. I shall look forward to seeing the fruits of your labors.

190.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_100
190.description: To finally see Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato embracing the world without... 'Tis nothing short of a dream come true. I cannot thank you enough.

191.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_004_101
191.description: Heh, even Jikkan's a staunch supporter of the cause now. Let's keep up the good work. So! What kind of wares should we bring in next?

192.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_102
192.description: There is something which I have had in mind for a time. As it is not urgent in nature, I had set it aside until such time as we had addressed our citizens' more pressing needs.

193.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_103
193.description: In our libraries, there exists a tome that describes a continent floating in the firmament. An enigmatic place called the Sea of Clouds, said to be home to countless treasures.

194.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_104
194.description: I should be grateful if you could bring me one such treasure. It would serve as a token, I believe, of the vastness of the world─a reminder to our people to turn their gaze ever outward.

195.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_SANANA_004_105
195.description: Come now, Princess, you just want to see the treasure for yourself.

196.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_106
196.description: Hehe, a claim I shan't refute. And if truth be told, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, there is another favor I would ask of you.

197.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_107
197.description: You will recall that, for our visit to Kugane, I had the opportunity to dress as the locals do. Simply donning the attire provided me with many an insight into the culture whence it came.

198.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_108
198.description: I have since learned of wondrous objects called glamour prisms. Through them, I would be grateful if you could alter the appearance of my garments, thereby allowing me to gain an insight into even more cultures.

199.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_LCUT_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_109
199.description: However strange the method may seem, if it grants me deeper understanding of the outside world, I am open to it. Should you come upon any likely garments in your travels, I ask that you reserve them for me.

200.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUPINFO_000_000
200.description: Kurenai is pleased with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Supporter of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato's Emergence<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

201.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUPINFO_000_001
201.description: Kurenai is delighted with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Stalwart of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato's Emergence<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

202.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUPINFO_000_002
202.description: Kurenai is overjoyed with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Savior of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato's Emergence<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

203.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUPINFO_000_003
203.description: Kurenai could not be happier with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Shining Light to the World<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

204.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUPINFO_001_001
204.description: And yet there is still much work to be done if the people of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato are to shed their apprehensions towards the outside world. To that end, Kurenai has a new favor to ask of you...

205.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUPINFO_001_002
205.description: Through your efforts, the people of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato have come to embrace the outside world. It seems, however, that Kurenai has a different sort of favor to ask of you...

206.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_AFTRANKUP_000_001
206.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Kurenai has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Kurenai and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

207.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_AFTRANKUP_001_001
207.description: A new quest continuing the story of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato's emergence into the world is now available. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for Kurenai will be updated.

208.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_AFTRANKUP_002_001
208.description: Future requests will be selected at random from all those you have seen thus far, with the list refreshed once a week (Earth time).

209.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_AFTRANKUP_002_002
209.description: You may review the items currently in demand at any time by speaking with Kurenai and selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

210.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_AFTRANKUP_002_003
210.description: Note that cloud pearls, cloudkin feathers, and Illuminati masks will earn you particularly handsome rewards. Whenever they make an appearance, the effort to procure them will be worth your while.

211.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_AFTRANKUP_002_004
211.description: Furthermore, Kurenai's appearance may now be altered through the use of glamours.

212.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_000
212.description: I am truly grateful for your many contributions, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

213.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_001_001
213.description: At risk of repeating myself, I find myself marveling at your versatility. Is there naught that you cannot do?

214.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_000
214.description: On behalf of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato, I offer you my humblest thanks.

215.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_002_001
215.description: I am seeing more smiles upon the people's faces than ever before, and it is due to your generous contributions.

216.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_000
216.description: That I am able to continue as I am, striving for the betterment of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato's future, is because of you, my friend.

217.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_001
217.description: Now, while we are grateful for your continued cooperation, you mustn't overwork yourself.

218.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_003_002
218.description: Glad though I am for your visits, the kami knows there are others out there who have need of you. 'Twould not do to keep your many talents for ourselves.

219.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_000
219.description: Thank you as always for your kind contribution, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

220.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_001
220.description: The items you bring are a source of great joy for my people. But that is not all. They also give me no small amount of personal pleasure.

221.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_004_002
221.description: Hehe, a little side benefit for my efforts, shall we say?

222.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_005_000
222.description: Thank you yet again for your plentiful contributions, my friend.

223.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_005_001
223.description: Lest you wonder, I have been returning to Shisui regularly in order to discharge my official duties. And en route back, I make a point of visiting our libraries.

224.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_005_002
224.description: There I scour our tomes for references to the items you bring, that I might learn about their places of origin. While it is no substitute for firsthand experience, I am glad nonetheless for these little glimpses of the outside world.

225.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_006_000
225.description: By now you must be royally sick of hearing my words of thanks...but I shall thank you again all the same.

226.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_006_001
226.description: Do you remember when we first spoke? The day I beseeched your aid in purging the palace of the wraiths. That day, I did not dream that ours would become such an enduring friendship. That I would come to depend upon you so.

227.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_006_002
227.description: 'Tis no exaggeration when I say that you are a savior to Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato. And to me personally, you are a shining light to the great wide world beyond.

228.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_RANKUP_KURENAI_006_003
228.description: As much as I have already learned, I still have far to go if I am to stand shoulder to shoulder with you. While I doubt that I ever will, I shall never stop striving, and I pray that you will ever continue to watch over me.

229.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER3_00481_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
229.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Kurenai. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).
